title.zh: 企業永續發展與 ESG 戰略 (首席永續長 / CSO 視角)

slide_title.zh: 合規海嘯與戰略轉型訴求 (SCQA & The Ask)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：各國主管機關及核心供應鏈 (如 Apple, 歐盟 CBAM) 已將淨零碳排與 ESG 揭露列為強制法規
衝突 (Complication)：若公司仍將 ESG 視為「公關包裝 (Greenwashing)」，將面臨供應鏈剔除、碳稅重罰與外資撤資的生存危機
戰略訴求 (The Ask)：提議由「合規驅動」轉向「價值創造」，懇請董事會核准設立隸屬董事會層級的永續委員會及轉型預算
en: Situation: Global regulators and apex supply chains (e.g., Apple, EU CBAM) now mandate Net-Zero targets and stringent ESG disclosures.
Complication: Treating ESG merely as a PR exercise (Greenwashing) exposes us to supply chain exclusion, carbon taxes, and capital flight.
The Ask: Pivot from 'compliance-driven' to 'value-driven' ESG. Requesting Board approval to establish a Board-level Sustainability Committee and transition budget.

speaker_notes.zh: 各位董事，ESG 早就不是公關議題，而是『生存門票』。歐盟的碳邊境稅 (CBAM) 和大客戶的減碳要求已經兵臨城下。如果我們繼續把 ESG 當作寫漂亮的永續報告書（漂綠），我們將面臨掉單與外資撤資的風險。今天的提案，是要將 ESG 正式升級為驅動公司增長的核心商業戰略。
speaker_notes.en: Members of the Board, ESG is no longer a PR exercise; it is our 'license to operate.' With EU CBAM and Tier-1 clients demanding decarbonization, treating ESG as cosmetic 'greenwashing' risks massive revenue loss and capital flight. Today's pitch elevates ESG from a compliance checklist to a core driver of commercial value.

slide_title.zh: 雙重重大性評估 (Double Materiality Assessment)

zh: 財務重大性 (Financial Materiality - Outside In)：評估極端氣候與碳定價如何實質衝擊公司的廠房資產與 P&L 損益表
衝擊重大性 (Impact Materiality - Inside Out)：檢視公司營運與產品生命週期，對生態環境及社會人權造成的外部影響
聚焦矩陣 (Focus Matrix)：透過雙重重大性矩陣，篩選出未來 3 年最具戰略價值的 5 項核心 ESG 議題，集中資源攻堅
en: Financial Materiality (Outside-In): Assessing how climate risks and carbon pricing physically and financially impact our P&L and assets.
Impact Materiality (Inside-Out): Evaluating the external footprint our operations and product lifecycles leave on the environment and human rights.
Focus Matrix: Utilizing the Double Materiality matrix to pinpoint the top 5 strategic ESG priorities for the next 3 years, concentrating our CapEx.

speaker_notes.zh: 要推動 ESG，我們不能什麼都做，必須精準打擊。我們導入國際標準的『雙重重大性』評估。第一，氣候變遷會讓我們賠多少錢？第二，我們對環境造成了多少衝擊？透過這個矩陣，我們排除了那些不痛不癢的表面功夫，把資金集中在能真正降低營運風險的核心議題上。
speaker_notes.en: We cannot boil the ocean; our ESG efforts must be laser-focused. We utilize the global 'Double Materiality' standard. First: How much financial damage will climate risks cause us? Second: What is our exact impact on the environment? This matrix filters out cosmetic initiatives, directing capital strictly toward managing core operational risks.

slide_title.zh: 淨零路徑與範疇三減碳 (Net-Zero & Scope 3 Decarbonization)

zh: 科學基礎減碳 (SBTi)：承諾符合 1.5°C 情境的減碳路徑，目標於 2030 年減碳 [X]%，2050 年達成淨零 (Net-Zero)
範疇三挑戰 (Scope 3 Challenge)：高達 [X]% 的碳排來自供應鏈與產品使用端，這已非單一部門能解決的系統性難題
供應鏈賦能 (Supply Chain Empowerment)：將碳排指標納入採購合約 (SLA)，並協助一/二階供應商進行碳盤查與綠電轉型
en: SBTi Commitment: Committing to a 1.5°C-aligned decarbonization trajectory, targeting a [X]% reduction by 2030 and Net-Zero by 2050.
The Scope 3 Challenge: [X]% of our total emissions stem from the value chain (Scope 3)—a systemic challenge requiring cross-functional intervention.
Supply Chain Empowerment: Integrating carbon metrics into procurement SLAs and directly subsidizing Tier 1/2 suppliers in their green transition.

speaker_notes.zh: 減碳的深水區在『範疇三 (Scope 3)』，也就是我們上下游供應鏈的碳排，這往往佔了公司總碳排的七成以上。我們將向 SBTi 遞交科學減碳目標，並聯合採購長 (CPO)，把碳排標準寫進未來的供應商合約裡。無法跟上我們減碳步伐的供應商，將被逐步淘汰。
speaker_notes.en: The deep water of decarbonization is 'Scope 3'—our upstream and downstream value chain, which accounts for over 70% of our footprint. We will submit our targets to SBTi and partner with the CPO to integrate carbon metrics into all future supplier contracts. Vendors unable to match our decarbonization pace will be systematically phased out.

slide_title.zh: 綠色金融與資本成本 (Green Finance & Cost of Capital)
slide_title.en: Green Finance & Lowering Cost of Capital

zh: 永續連結貸款 (SLL)：與銀行團重新議約，將融資利率與 ESG 績效 (如減碳/多元化) 掛鉤，達標即可降低利息成本
內部碳定價 (Internal Carbon Pricing, ICP)：於企業內部實施每噸 [X 美元] 的碳定價，倒逼各事業群 (BU) 在決策時納入氣候成本
綠色溢價 (Green Premium)：透過低碳產品研發，獲取對環境敏感型客戶的溢價定價權，直接貢獻營收成長
en: Sustainability-Linked Loans (SLL): Renegotiating credit lines to peg interest rates to ESG KPIs, lowering debt servicing costs upon target achievement.
Internal Carbon Pricing (ICP): Implementing an ICP of [$X/ton], forcing all Business Units (BUs) to factor climate externalities into CapEx decisions.
Green Premium: Achieving premium pricing power with environmentally conscious clients through low-carbon R&D, directly driving top-line growth.

speaker_notes.zh: ESG 不是只會花錢，它能為公司省錢甚至賺錢。我們將引入『內部碳定價』，讓各部門在花錢時感受到排碳的痛感。同時，我們正在與銀行洽談『永續連結貸款 (SLL)』，只要我們達到減碳 KPI，就能享受降息，實質降低公司的資金成本 (Cost of Capital)。
speaker_notes.en: ESG is not a cost center; it is an economic lever. We are deploying 'Internal Carbon Pricing' so BUs feel the financial sting of their emissions. Concurrently, we are negotiating 'Sustainability-Linked Loans' (SLL). Hitting our ESG KPIs will trigger interest rate discounts, structurally lowering our enterprise Cost of Capital.

slide_title.zh: 治理架構與百日行動計畫 (Governance & 100-Day Plan)

zh: 董事會治理 (Board Oversight)：成立直屬董事會的「永續發展委員會」，確保氣候風險融入最高決策體系
高管薪酬掛鉤 (Executive Remuneration)：將 ESG 核心 KPI (如減碳進度) 與 C-Level 及總經理的年度獎金強制掛鉤
決策訴求 (Call to Action)：懇請核准 ESG 轉型預算，並於 100 天內完成首版「雙重重大性」評估與內部碳定價機制試行
en: Board Oversight: Charters a Board-level 'Sustainability Committee' to ensure climate risks are embedded in ultimate strategic decisions.
Executive Remuneration: Forcing the linkage of core ESG KPIs (e.g., decarbonization rates) to C-Suite and GM annual bonus pools.
Call to Action: Requesting transition budget approval to execute the inaugural 'Double Materiality' audit and pilot the Internal Carbon Pricing mechanism within 100 days.

speaker_notes.zh: 再好的戰略，沒有治理架構都是空談。我們提議在董事會下設立專屬的永續委員會，更關鍵的是，我們要把 ESG 目標與高階主管的獎金直接綁定，讓『永續』成為每個人的切身利益。懇請董事會核准這項百日轉型計畫，讓我們從法規的追隨者，變成市場的領導者。
speaker_notes.en: Strategy without governance is merely a wish. We propose chartering a dedicated Board-level Sustainability Committee. More critically, we must link ESG targets directly to executive bonuses—making sustainability a personal financial imperative for leadership. We ask the Board to approve this 100-day transition plan, turning us from regulatory followers into market leaders.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『企業永續發展與 ESG 戰略』簡報。受眾為董事會或最高管理層。內容必須展現首席永續長 (CSO) 的高度，將 ESG 從公關合規轉化為商業價值：1. 運用 SCQA 框架指出全球合規海嘯與不作為的生存風險，2. 導入『雙重重大性 (Double Materiality)』進行精準資源投放，3. 探討最具挑戰的『範疇三 (Scope 3)』供應鏈減碳與 SBTi 科學路徑，4. 用財務語言 (CFO 視角) 說明『內部碳定價 (ICP)』與『永續連結貸款 (SLL)』如何降低資金成本，5. 結尾必須提出將 ESG 與高管薪酬掛鉤的強硬治理架構，並給出 100 天行動計畫。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需充滿推動變革的魄力與無懈可擊的商業邏輯。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Enterprise Sustainability & ESG Strategy' presentation in English. Audience: Board of Directors or C-Suite. Demonstrate the Chief Sustainability Officer's (CSO) capability to transform ESG from PR into raw commercial value: 1. Use SCQA to frame the regulatory tsunami and existential risks of greenwashing. 2. Deploy 'Double Materiality' for precise strategic capital allocation. 3. Tackle the brutal reality of 'Scope 3' value chain decarbonization and SBTi pathways. 4. Speak the CFO's language by introducing 'Internal Carbon Pricing (ICP)' and 'Sustainability-Linked Loans (SLL)' to lower the Cost of Capital. 5. Conclude with ruthless governance—linking ESG KPIs to executive remuneration—and a 100-day execution plan. Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must project immense transformative resolve and airtight commercial logic.
